patch_description: The current flat single-block ansatz (score 0.86) underperforms the earlier modular two-block design (score 0.89) that used per-qubit RY, alternating-shared ring CRZ, RX layer, skip-2/skip-3 CRZ, and single-parameter diameter CRZ, repeated twice with fully shared parameters. Reverting to that stronger modular structure recovers the higher score baseline. On top of that, I apply the recommended targeted tweak: partially de-share the ring CRZ parameters across the two block repetitions (block 0 gets its own "crz_ring_even_b0"/"crz_ring_odd_b0", block 1 keeps the original "crz_ring_even"/"crz_ring_odd"), while keeping skip-2, skip-3, and diameter parameters fully shared across both blocks. This adds only 2 extra parameters but gives the first entangling layer block-specific flexibility, which may help the circuit build a more useful initial local-correlation structure before the shared mid/long-range mixing layers, without sacrificing the parameter-sharing stability benefits that drove the previous good result.
